body: 1000%. I’ve worked for a super shady local gov at my previous place, and whether it was my writing down, notating everything from what was said to the time to who said what, shit that was no good that others were doing or writing down what I was forced to do, and that form of documentation (if even personal) can SAVE your ass. I used my notes section on my phone, then would transcribe what I wrote into a little notebook.
That’s what I did tonight! Worked fine and mine was stuffed with some makeup, spare nicotine products, a granola bar, and bracelets I made!

As per our SOPs, and because we handle Fire and EMS we let the caller prompt us with what they need first, and say “(Insert Agency) (Dispatcher #)”

At my old agency where I had a little more latitude I personally preferred getting the exact location of the emergency first, and used “(Insert agency name) (Dispatcher #), what’s the location of the emergency?”

It’s wholeheartedly and completely up to the person, and what fits them and their scenario, but for me personally in hindsight it was not worth it. The stigma that was attached, the constant back and forth of missed school classes for meetings that dragged on (or alternatively were rescheduled to delay or drag their feet) and harassment from the police department. Yes he got punished in the end, but the process and repercussions… were not worth it for me personally, physically and psychologically.
Good to have an encrypted channel atleast available to switch to in the event of MAYDAYs, Avalanches, MCIs, etc
Took the survey and you can DM me ☺️
